title: Wet room without modern waterproofing

mitigation.action: Bathroom renovation partner installs a waterproof membrane and new floor drain seals

known_quirks: Wet rooms built before 1998 usually have only a moisture barrier paint or nothing at all
Tile grout is not waterproof; water reaches the structure through it
Signs: dark grout lines, loose tiles, musty smell, dark marks on the ceiling below
why_hint: DRAFT: The wet room was built before 1999 and has no record of a waterproofing renovation. Finnish building code required a waterproof membrane only from 1998.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: Waterproofing stops shower water from soaking the floor and wall structures, the most expensive moisture damage in a house.
